visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an eye-level shot of an orange and white cat perched high atop a tall, black-framed glass display cabinet. The cat looks down toward the camera with a curious yet detached expression, its ears slightly forward. The background consists of a neutral-toned ceiling and warm indoor lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a medium shot of a calico cat walking across a light-colored carpeted floor. The cat looks directly into the lens, its tail low. (3) A close-up shows a brown tabby cat sitting on the floor; a human hand enters from the left, pointing a finger toward the cat. The cat leans in slightly to sniff the finger, maintaining a calm demeanor. (4) A black cat is seen curled up in a brown, plush donut-style cat bed inside what appears to be a pink-lined enclosure. The owner's hand reaches in to stroke the cat's head, but the cat remains relatively still and slightly aloof. (5) A tabby cat sits comfortably on a white pedestal with a blue-and-white striped cushion. As the human hand strokes its head and back, the cat licks the owner's fingers affectionately, its eyes partially closing in enjoyment. (6) A tabby cat is filmed from a high angle as it runs briskly toward a wooden door adorned with a yellow cat-patterned curtain. (7) An orange tabby cat is seen resting inside a dark, circular cat house integrated into a white bookshelf. The cat's mouth is open as if meowing loudly. The owner's hand enters the frame to pet the cat under its chin, and the cat responds by stretching its neck. (8) The camera captures a tabby cat exploring a corner near a desk, surrounded by catnip toys and a food bowl. (9) The final phase shows a small piece of cat waste on the floor near a chair, followed by a shot of the orange tabby cat being petted while standing on a light-colored surface.
